name: Longmont (United States)
description: White field charged with a red letter L and a blue horizontal bar forming a stylised mountain-and-plain emblem with a white disc for the sun.
history: Longmont is a home rule city in Boulder and Weld counties, Colorado. Flags of the World records that the flag was designed in a 1974 Rotary Club contest, awarded on 29 May 1974 and officially adopted on 1 April 1975; it flew in space with Longmont native Vance Brand on the 1975 Apollo–Soyuz mission and the 1984 Challenger flight.

features.role: horizontal bar with a white disc
